_comment: The complete error surface of M01. Every response body is the frozen envelope from contracts/common/error-envelope.schema.json; this file fixes which (code, message_key) pairs M01 may return and at which status. Adding a pair is a contract revision.
_rule: A refusal reason is never elaborated to the client. 'error.action_denied' is returned for every authorisation failure regardless of which grant or relationship was missing, because a precise reason tells an unauthorised actor what to acquire. The precise ReasonCode is recorded in the audit row instead.

responses.when: No session, or a session that has been revoked.
The pre-authentication challenge passed its expiry. The client must restart at /auth/login.
Unknown challenge id, already-consumed challenge, or too many failed attempts. Deliberately one key for all three so an attacker cannot enumerate challenge ids.
A business endpoint was called with a password-only session. Enrol or complete the factor.
A sensitive write was called and the factor was asserted longer ago than the action allows. Re-assert.
Factor enrolment, replacement or disable was attempted without a recent password confirmation.
Authorisation failed. Covers no grant, expired grant, missing relationship and unknown action.
An attempt to disable 2FA on an account whose role requires it.
The object does not exist, OR exists in another school. Deliberately indistinguishable.
expected_version did not match the stored aggregate version.
Enrolment confirmation attempted when an active factor already exists.
A recovery code was replayed. Exactly one concurrent use wins.
The change would leave the school with no active owner.
A recovery case was approved or rejected more than once.
Malformed or missing input, or an unknown write field.
The request body carried a field the endpoint does not accept. Named in field_errors.
The actor tried to grant a permission or scope broader than their own.
The proposed role graph contains a cycle.
A TOTP code did not validate, was outside the accepted step window, or was replayed.
Throttled by account or by IP. Carries a progressive cooldown; never a permanent attacker-triggered lockout.

_status_note: 429 is outside B00's original 401/403/404/409/422 set. It is added as a real ErrorCode (rate_limited -> 429) rather than by returning 429 with a 422 code, because B00's invariant is that the code determines the status and the shared renderer derives one from the other. The response carries Retry-After.
